source_packet.text: The original pilot abstract reported mean questions per session of six with the form and four without it. Six sessions were assigned, three per condition. Willingness and learning were not measured.

The original abstract transposed an extraction value. Corrected mean question counts are six in each condition. This is a correction of the same six-session pilot, not a second experiment. No willingness or learning outcomes were collected.

In a survey of48 staff at one company, self-selected users of the form reported greater willingness to speak than nonusers. Form use was not assigned. No full methods or long-term learning results are supplied.

Eight volunteers described their experiences. Some welcomed private question submission; others worried colleagues could infer their identity from timing or distinctive wording. Interviews did not estimate population prevalence.
